anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex, large-radius curvature forming a bulbous anterior-dorsal boundary profile.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white linear striations and irregular depigmented patches across the dorsal and lateral melon surface.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast pale illumination/pigmentation at the anterior snout tip; dark ocular region; visible elongated pectoral fin extending ventrally.
